Lesson 6

Manager Challenge

Apply the complete ER decision-making framework to a realistic workplace situation.

Your Manager Challenge

Now it's your turn. Read the situation and decide what you would do next. Use the same decision-making process you have used throughout the course.

Medical Certificate Concern

Scenario

An employee submits a medical certificate after being absent from work. Part of the document appears to have been altered and the dates look different.

The employee says: "The doctor made the correction." A colleague believes the employee should be dismissed immediately.

What should you do first?

Which Common Law Duty may be most relevant?

Before deciding on disciplinary action, which questions should the manager consider?

If dismissal may be a possible outcome, what should the manager do?

How a Good Manager Approached the Situation

  1. 1Gathered facts before actingNo assumptions.
  2. 2Identified the workplace expectation involvedBe Honest.
  3. 3Applied the fairness questionsFacts and consistency first.
  4. 4Focused on behaviour correctionDiscipline has a purpose.
  5. 5Sought support where requiredEspecially when dismissal may be possible.

What would you do differently now?

Your response is for personal reflection and will not be assessed.
